questions.scenario: You are feeling a bit magical today. What would you like to do?

options.text: Look at the night sky, stars, and track the moon phases.
Rearrange my room's furniture so it feels more 'positive'.
Play with a deck of cards or find out my lucky number.
Sit quietly, close my eyes, and do deep breathing.
Look at my own palms and try to decode what the lines say about my future.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Your friend is very sad about failing a test. How do you comfort them?

options.text: Tell them, 'Don't worry, your time/luck will change next month!'
Take them out of their dark room to an open, fresh, well-lit place.
Open a random page of a book to find a 'hidden sign' for them.
Just hold their hand, listen patiently, and help them find peace.
Look at their palm lines and tell them they have a strong success line waiting to show up.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You visit a completely new house. What is the first thing you notice?

options.text: What time we entered the house (is it an auspicious time?).
Which direction the windows face and where the sunlight comes from.
The house number and whether it adds up to my lucky digit.
The 'vibe' of the house—whether it feels heavy or peaceful.
The facial expressions and subtle body language of the people living there to see if they are genuinely happy.
None of these.

questions.scenario: If you were granted a mystical superpower, what would you choose?

options.text: The ability to perfectly predict a person's future.
The ability to instantly remove bad energy from any room.
The ability to decode secret messages from random symbols.
The ability to take away a person's sadness just by talking.
The ability to instantly know a person's true character and past just by looking at their face.
None of these.

questions.scenario: What kind of mysterious objects fascinate you the most?

options.text: Telescopes, birth-charts, and the Zodiac signs.
Wind-chimes, crystals, and indoor lucky bamboo plants.
Beautifully painted old cards and lucky charms.
Incense sticks (agarbatti) and meditation beads.
Old books showing the meanings of different palm lines, face shapes, and moles.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Things are going very wrong today. Everything is a mess. What is your thought process?

options.text: 'It's just a bad day, the planets/stars are probably not aligned right.'
'My room is too messy, let me clean it to fix the energy.'
'Why am I seeing the number 4 everywhere today? Is it a warning?'
'I need to close my eyes, detach, and calm my own mind first.'
'Let me check my palm lines or look at my tired face in the mirror to see what this phase means.'
None of these.

questions.scenario: You have to buy a gift for your best friend. What do you choose?

options.text: A cool coffee mug with their Zodiac sign (like Leo or Aries) on it.
A beautiful painting of a waterfall to bring peace to their room.
A lucky bracelet or a pendant with a special symbol.
A personal journal or a book about finding happiness.
A beginner's guide to reading faces and palms so we can analyze our classmates.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Every path has a tough or boring part. Which of these can you tolerate easily?

options.text: Memorizing exact dates, times, and planetary positions.
Using a compass to measure the exact angles and directions of walls.
Doing lots of math to calculate someone's life path numbers.
Listening to a person cry about the same problem for 3 hours.
Staring closely at tiny, confusing lines on hundreds of hands to figure out what they mean.
None of these.

questions.scenario: How do you prefer to organize your personal things?

options.text: Based on a strict daily routine or the time of the day.
Based on how the room 'feels' when I walk inside.
I like keeping my favorite items in sets of 3, 5, or 7.
I don't care much about physical things; my mind should be clear.
I care less about objects and more about the people around me, constantly observing their expressions.
None of these.

questions.scenario: In your friend group, what title fits you the best?

options.text: The Predictor (Who knows what will happen next).
The Decorator (Who fixes the vibe of the place).
The Mystery Solver (Who reads the hidden signs).
The Therapist (Who heals everyone's heart).
The Face Reader (Who knows what you're thinking just by looking at you).
None of these.
